title: Afternoon on the Amazon
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie explore the Amazon rain forest and meet jaguars, piranhas, and a helpful monkey — 杰克和安妮探秘亚马逊雨林，遇见美洲豹、食人鱼和一只热心的猴子！🌳

q.en: Where does the tree house land when they reach the Amazon?
q.zh: 到达亚马逊时，树屋降落在哪里？

options.en: In the forest canopy, over 150 feet up
options.zh: 在森林树冠层，150多英尺高

options.en: On the dark, wet, muddy forest floor far below
options.zh: 在下方黑暗、潮湿又泥泞的森林地面上

explain.en: Jack reads the rain forest has a top layer called the canopy, often over 150 feet up; they had landed in the bushes of the canopy.
explain.zh: 杰克读到雨林最上层叫'树冠层'，常超过150英尺高；他们正降落在树冠层的灌木丛里。

q.en: What marches through the dead leaves, sending the animals fleeing in panic?
q.zh: 是什么穿过枯叶，吓得动物们四散奔逃？

options.en: A troop of noisy, playful monkeys
options.zh: 一群吵闹又爱玩的猴子

explain.en: Jack reads that a crackling sound means '30 million flesh-eating army ants are marching through the dead leaves.'
explain.zh: 杰克读到，那种噼啪声意味着'三千万只食肉行军蚁正穿过枯叶行进'。

q.en: What are the blue fish with red bellies and razor-sharp teeth?
q.zh: 那些蓝身、红肚、长着剃刀般尖牙的鱼是什么？

options.zh: 飞鱼，发生在很久很久以前

explain.en: Annie calls them 'pretty fish,' but Jack warns they are piranhas that 'will eat anything! Even people!'
explain.zh: 安妮说它们是'漂亮的小鱼'，但杰克警告那是食人鱼，'什么都吃！连人都吃！'

q.en: What does the little monkey first throw at Jack and Annie?
q.zh: 小猴子最先朝杰克和安妮扔的是什么？

options.zh: 一块尖石头，在很远很远的地方

explain.en: The monkey grabs 'a big red fruit' hanging from the tree and hurls it at the canoe; later they learn it is the mango they need.
explain.zh: 猴子抓起树上'一颗红色的大果子'朝独木舟砸来；后来才知道那就是他们要找的芒果。

q.en: What baby animal with gold fur and black spots does Annie find on the forest floor?
q.zh: 安妮在森林地面上发现的那只金毛、带黑斑的幼小动物是什么？

options.zh: 小豹子，不过那是另一个故事了

explain.en: Jack reads that 'the jaguar is the biggest predator in the western hemisphere,' and the cute cub grows into that predator.
explain.zh: 杰克读到'美洲豹是西半球最大的掠食者'，而这只可爱的幼崽长大就是它。

q.en: What Amazon creatures bite their victims and suck blood after dark?
q.zh: 亚马逊里哪种生物会在天黑后叮咬猎物、吸它们的血？

explain.en: Jack reads: 'Vampire bats live in the Amazon rain forest. At night, they quietly bite their victims and suck their blood.'
explain.zh: 杰克读到：'吸血蝙蝠生活在亚马逊雨林。夜里，它们悄悄咬住猎物吸血。'

q.en: How long is the Amazon River, according to the rain forest book?
q.zh: 根据那本雨林书，亚马逊河有多长？

explain.en: Jack reads the Amazon 'stretches over 4,000 miles from the mountains of Peru... to the Atlantic Ocean.'
explain.zh: 杰克读到，亚马逊河'从秘鲁山脉……到大西洋，绵延超过四千英里'。

q.en: What special thing do they find for Morgan in the rain forest?
q.zh: 他们在雨林里为摩根找到的特别东西是什么？

explain.en: Annie realizes the red fruit the monkey gave them is 'the thing' — Jack later reads in the book that it is a mango.
explain.zh: 安妮明白猴子给的红果子就是'那件东西'——杰克后来在书里读到那是芒果。

q.en: Who leads Jack and Annie back to the tree house when they are lost?
q.zh: 当他们迷路时，是谁把杰克和安妮领回了树屋？

explain.en: They place Peanut on the leafy floor; she takes off and they follow the moving leaves and white streak right to the tree house ladder.
explain.zh: 他们把花生放在铺满落叶的地上；她跑起来，他们跟着晃动的叶子和那道白色踪迹，一直来到树屋的梯子前。

q.en: What do the first two found things — moonstone and mango — have in common?
q.zh: 已找到的前两件东西——月光石和芒果——有什么共同点？

options.en: Both names start with the letter M, like Morgan
options.zh: 它们的名字都以字母 M 开头，和摩根一样

options.en: Both come from the deep, salty ocean water far across the sea
options.zh: 它们都来自远跨大海、深邃又咸涩的海洋，那是别人讲的版本

explain.en: Jack notices 'Moonstone and mango start with the letter M. Just like Morgan,' and guesses all four things will start with M.
explain.zh: 杰克发现'月光石和芒果都以字母 M 开头，和摩根一样'，并猜四件东西都会以 M 开头。
